KIT reserves rooms in
student residences
for students from partner universities.
Accommodation is guaranteed
if students adhere to the application procedure and deadlines. Details are sent by email after admission to KIT.
The furnished single rooms cost between €250 and €350 per month and are rented for fixed lease periods:
October to March (winter semester)
and/or
April to September (summer semester)
. Please note that these rental periods are non-negotiable, and no alternative move-in or move-out dates are available.
Please note that accommodation prices on the private market are significantly higher than those in student dorms, and there is also
a risk of scams
. For this reason, we highly recommend applying for a room in a student dorm through us.
For students attending the
pre-semester German language course
(starting mid-September in the winter semester/mid-March in the summer semester), we recommend reserving accommodation in youth hostels, hostels, or Airbnb for the two weeks before the rental period of guaranteed rooms in the student residences. This must be arranged privately, as KIT unfortunately cannot assist with finding housing on the private market.

student_guide_sections.summary: 依個別官方來源及原文件期間作參考；年度未明列者不認定為116-1最終規定。
points: 住宿參考：海外交換生多住學生宿舍，通常以一或兩學期租約，常與他人共用廚房浴室；校方建議申請 Studierendenwerk，另列自主管理的 HaDiKo。（接待校現行公開交換指南；未明列學年，僅作參考，不作116-1甄選條件或自動提醒）
保險與簽證參考：KIT 海外交換指南要求入學具備有效健康保險，須在抵達前安排；頁面所列學生法定保險約每月 €140–150，適用資格與保費依保險機構核定。（接待校現行公開交換指南；未明列學年，僅作參考，不作116-1甄選條件或自動提醒）
課程參考：機械工程學院交換指南要求每學期至少20–30 ECTS，含語言或通識；此為該學院指南，不能套用全部KIT院系。（KIT Faculty of Mechanical Engineering incoming exchange students；未明列2027–28）
接待校語言參考：機械學院交換德語授課需B1，全英文課程或學士／碩士論文期望英語B2；良好基礎德語為強烈建議。學期前密集德語課不能代替申請所需語言證明。（機械工程／材料／機電學院incoming，非全KIT統一語言門檻。）
接待校語言參考：商管incoming須按選課語言交德語B1或英語B2證書；混合德英授課須兩種。A2/B1德語是強烈推薦，另無足夠德語者頁面要求參加學期前德語課。（Wirtschaftswissenschaften und Management學院交換；頁面課表為2026–27，語言常年段未標新期。）
課程參考：機械學院同頁先稱交換生每學期必修至少20–30 ECTS，後段又說不強制特定ECTS且20–30僅建議；保留內文衝突，不能把它升格成NTU或全KIT硬性規則。（僅機械學院incoming；已有20–30參考資訊需合併辨識衝突。）
課程參考：機械學院交換應至少約2/3選本學院課，最多35%其他院；部分有限名額課需另註冊，一學期交換不能修要求全年前置作業的Machine Design及Technical Mechanics成對課。（機械學院學士／碩士交換選課，非保證任意課均可選。）
接待校文件參考：機械學院Learning Agreement必填課名、ECTS、semester及LV或T-MACH代碼；缺代碼不予處理。海外交換使用申請官方表格，Erasmus另用online learning agreement。（院級初申Learning Agreement格式，區分海外與Erasmus。）
接待校資格參考：欲以交換期間寫學士或碩士論文者須自行找到題目與指導教授，KIT及母校負責人皆須同意；ISIM/IStO不代找。（機械學院incoming thesis；非全校交換學生一律需先找教授。）
行事曆參考：機械學院考試可能延伸至winter二月中至三月底、summer七月中至九月底，課程確定考試日於當學期公布；提早返校的提前或遠距考試僅例外由雙方同意。（機械學院常年考試期，不當作2027–28確定日曆。）
費用參考：機械交換頁列學期前3週德語密集課75歐、需至少80%出席及考試才通常有4 ECTS；每學期一門德語課免費但有限位。非EU/EEA延長至第3學期起有學費。（院級交換語言課費用及延長住宿學期情境，非degree1500歐通則。）
接待校文件參考：考試批改可能8週，成績齊全後學生自行列印成績單；退學後最多6個月仍可下載，電腦產生以驗證碼取代簽名。（機械incoming離校成績文件階段。）
保險與簽證參考：KIT註冊須由德國法定健保直接電子傳Meldegrund 10，保險卡或紙本會員證明不夠；私保／外國保單須德國法定健保檢查後通知。旅行保障另涵到校至4/1或10/1正式健保開始前。（校級註冊與overseas arrival頁互相印證；私人責任保險另為建議。）
費用參考：一般費用頁逾期續註冊罰款18歐，而機械交換頁寫15歐；保留版本衝突。一般頁學生會12歐明排除limited-term學生，degree新生非EU1500歐不能直接套短期交換。（全校fees與機械院常年頁，實際交換帳單未在原roster本文確定。）

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校公開資訊補查
student_guide_sections.summary: 依個別官方來源及原文件期間作參考；年度未明列者不認定為116-1最終規定。
points: 住宿參考：交換生住宿須透過TU Dortmund國際處在交換申請填寫，不直接聯絡Studierendenwerk。通常合住公寓但各有臥室，房型與位置一般無法指定。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
費用參考：頁面租金上限每月EUR525，含水電暖氣、網路及共用區每週清潔；押金EUR700，電話、廣播費及家財保險另計。未明列學年，租約價格須再確認。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
保險與簽證參考：交換生註冊須證明充分健康保險。德語密集班期間尚未正式註冊，德國學生保險未生效，須另備旅行/醫療保險；30歲以上須符合規定的私人保險。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
行事曆參考：TU Dortmund一般校曆Winter2026行政學期2026/10/1–2027/3/31、講課10/12–2/5；本頁各類學位入學／re-registration截止不代表一般partner交換deadline，非2027–28。（TU Dortmund semester2026/27；非incoming交換申請表）
課程參考：交換生可選17院系的學士及碩士層級課程，授課語言依課程為德文或英文；模組手冊供預選，下一學期完整課程通常在開學前很短時間才出現在LSF，須再查系所最新版。（Worldwide／ISEP／USA incoming exchange；未標學年，選課資訊而非語言檢定門檻）
接待校語言參考：交換生開學前有4週德語密集班、學期中亦有不同程度語言課且免費；這是學習支援，本文未列初申德語／英文檢定最低分。（incoming exchange；頁面未標此支援學年，另鏈結2023/24宣傳簡介不能替代當期門檻）
費用參考：交換生健康保險頁所列德國法定學生保險連長期照護約每月EUR140–146；未標學年，只可作費用參考，30歲以上須改用符合規定的私人保險。（Worldwide／ISEP／USA incoming exchange，錄取後註冊健康保險；未標年費用）
接待校資格參考：一般交換入口對象為全球合作校學生，可停留一或二學期；DoGEP另限定美國合作校，短期及實習另屬不同計畫，不能把入口介紹當作完整申請條件。（incoming partner exchange；DoGEP美國校、短期及實習分流）

【住宿資訊】
The private housing market in Heidelberg is very tight, and living in residence halls run by the Studierendenwerk is the most affordable and most convenient way of staying in Heidelberg as an exchange student.
Types of accommodation include:
single room sharing kitchen and bathrooms in groups of 2-4
single room in dormitories with kitchens and bathrooms on each floor
a small number of single apartments
Fees for residence halls: Approx. 250 - 570 € / Month; 450 € refundable deposit
More information here

campus_life_summary:
【實用資訊】
Exchange students whose major is not German/Germanistik are strongly encouraged to register for the
4-week intensive preparatory German language course
at the International Study Center (ISZ). The course is offered before the start of the semester, in September for fall semester students and in March for spring semester students. The fee for the preparatory German language course is covered by the International Relations Office for exchange students.
Courses at the International Study Centre
Cost of Living: Approx. 900 - 1000 € / month. Please refer to the information on financial planning given
on this website
.
Health insurance
with unlimited coverage is compulsory for all Heidelberg University students. Exchange Students are advised to take out health insurance in Germany (a highly comprehensive coverage), or to ensure to bring full and unlimited health insurance coverage from their country of residence.

valid in Germany for enrolment as a fulltime student at FU Berlin AND for obtaining a residence permit.
Exchange students are exempt from university fees, but they still need to pay the so-called semester ticket and social fees of approx. € 330 per semester.These fees are not paid to the university, but instead go to the student union and cover the cost of a public transportation ticket for the Berlin metropolitan area for the entire semester. Freie Universität Berlin offers two scholarships for a period of ten months (1 October 2027 – 31 July 2028) with the following terms:
- € 800 as a monthly grant;
- € 500 health insurance allowance per semester;
- Reimbursement of student fees (approx. € 300 per semester);
- A waiver of registration fees.

Accommodation Service
offers a variety of housing options, including dorms, shared apartments, and fully furnished single apartments. Availability runs from the beginning of September/October or March/April onwards. Costs range from about € 500 to € 1200 per month.

first-come, first-served basis

housing_summary:
【住宿資訊】
The University of Athens runs a
Student Residence Complex
(FEPA/ΦΕΠΑ in Greek) on campus consisting of 4 buildings (A, B, C, D), which can house 1064 students.
In addition to student residences, there are various ways to find a flat in Athens, ranging from advertisements to agencies and digital services.
Most apartments are unfurnished, while those near the city centre are usually old or recently renovated. Rent costs don't include public utility services (electricity, water, heating, telephone line, and internet). There is also a typical extra cost, a
building fee
, which is shared with the tenants, for services such as cleaners, gardeners, elevator maintenance, electricity for shared building spaces, etc.
Renting an apartment requires signing a
lease contract
, which is necessary for establishing tenant rights and responsibilities.
More information here
.
transport_summary: 尚未取得並核對116-1適用資料；請向合作校確認。
campus_life_summary:
【實用資訊】
Budget for accommodation and studies
Accommodation
: A one-bedroom student flat costs approximately €300-400 and furnishing it may cost up to €1000.
Food
: Students can eat free of charge at campus restaurants and there also are many affordable options in the city of Athens.
Public Transport
(student discount): 0,50€ valid for 90-minutes/ 30-day fare: 13,5€ / 180-day fare for countless rides: 77,50€
VISA application information
: Non-European Union citizens need a study visa to enter the country, which may take up to 3 months to be issued! Study visas are issued by the Greek consulate of the country of origin and are of type D (Visa D 1.1). Visa applications should be made upon acceptance to your programme of choice. In case of entering the country with a tourist visa or a Schengen visa for another country, you cannot change it into a student residence permit.
Private insurance contract for non-European Union students:
The insurance contract to be submitted with the residency permit or its extension, should include:
Health care in public hospitals: 10.000€ annually with owncontribution of 20%.
Permanent (total or partial) impairment insurance caused by an accident: 15.000€ annually with own contribution of 20%.
Illness or accident-related medical and pharmaceutical expenses: 1.500€ annually with own contribution of 20%.
The contract should indicate that it covers expenses defined by the law/ministerial decision and should explicitly mention that it covers everything that might occur to the student during their stay in the country. If there has already been another insurance contract, from your country of origin, it can be used if officially translated into Greek, as long as it includes the above provisions. In any other case, students may sign a Greek financial contract agreement with an insurance company. The cost
starts from 60€ per year
.

housing_summary:
【住宿資訊】
We strongly advise students to apply for accommodation through the International Office. Students can only start this process after their exchange application has been approved.
A handling fee of €250 per semester is required for this service. The number of rooms available is limited, accommodation cannot be guaranteed, and is assigned on a
first-paid, first-served basis
. Rental periods are fixed and cannot be adjusted to the student's arrival and/or departure dates.
Further information can be found
on our website
.

campus_life_summary:
【實用資訊】
Students can take Dutch
language courses
at the Department of Dutch as a Second Language.
Insurance
: VU Amsterdam requires all incoming international students to be properly insured by an internationally recognised insurance agency for the duration of their stay (this is also required by Dutch law).
Living in Amsterdam can be expensive. Make sure that you have sufficient financial means to cover the costs of living.
Experience shows that living and studying in the Netherlands for one year costs a student between €1,000 and €1,100 per month. Some students manage to spend less, but this of course depends on your own lifestyle (and type of accommodation). An indication of likely monthly expenses:
Rent for housing average: €600 (price range €366 - €1,045)
Food: €250
Insurance: €100
Public transport: €50
Books: €50
Other costs: €50
Total (average): €1,100
VISA application information

Healthcare insurance
By law, everyone in the Netherlands, even if you are here for only one or two semesters, must have healthcare insurance for medical expenses. The type of healthcare insurance you need depends on your situation. Please check your current insurance to see if it covers your stay in the Netherlands and to what extent.
Liability insurance and household contents insurance

MyMaastricht
or
Study in Holland
.

housing_summary:
【住宿資訊】
We must strongly advise you to arrange this urgently because available student housing in Maastricht is
very limited
. We strongly advise you not to come to Maastricht if you have not found housing in or around the city before the start of the academic year. Should you come to Maastricht against our advice without having arranged housing, please know that UM cannot help you because UM itself does not offer student housing, and there are no online classes.
For more information, have a look at
UM Guesthouse
. Please take into account the mandatory introduction days and examination days when booking a room.

The official language at SBE (and the rest of Maastricht University) is English, but you might want to learn some Dutch. Learning Dutch will make your life as a student in Maastricht a lot easier.
If you decide to take a language course this will not be mentioned on your SBE exchange transcript, as it is not taught at SBE but the Language Centre. However, you will receive a separate Proof of Participation from the Language Centre itself.

Estimated living expenses
: On average, students will need at least €968 – €1338 per month. Also see
financial matters
. Please note that public transport is not free for exchange students, but discount cards are available.
All students are obliged to have
health insurance
to cover any medical costs incurred during their stay. We strongly recommend that students ensure they have medical insurance before their arrival. Students are also highly recommended to take out liability insurance to cover any accidental damage caused to other persons or property.
housing_summary:
【住宿資訊】
Prospective students are advised to apply for housing in a very early stage, and to
pay the housing application fee (€285) as early as possible after application
. An application for housing can be submitted via the application portal as soon as their application for admission has been submitted. There is no need to await a decision on their application for admission to Leiden University. Once a student has reserved an accommodation via University Housing, the housing agency DUWO further coordinates the process.
Housing
through Leiden University cannot be guaranteed, we insist that students also seek housing via other routes. If a student needs to find housing independently Leiden University can give
advice and tips
. Please be informed that private housing can be expensive and is scarce.

student_guide_sections.summary: 依個別官方來源及原文件期間作參考；年度未明列者不認定為116-1最終規定。
points: 保險與簽證參考：incoming exchange由Student IN投保，條款自2025/7/1版本起；全校人身事故保障限校內及往返途中，仍應逐項核對校外醫療與房東家財保險要求，不當作全情境完整保障。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
住宿參考：KTH住房服務按學生群組區分：部分保證、部分僅有空房才提供、部分须自行找房。不可由服務存在推定臺大交換生自動保證；需讀交換生類別資格與申請頁。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
課程參考：KTH一般交換選30ECTS/學期，多數需在母校協議學科並符合各課先修；建築須專屬協議及完成三年，有固定學習計畫；不將一般英授碩士多課數視為全部課可選。（KTH exchange；Architecture另外要求）
行事曆參考：KTH標題及日期表為2027–28（秋2027/8/30–2028/1/17、春1/18–6/2），導言卻說2026–27。逐項保留此版本文字矛盾，不宣稱整頁已一致核實。（KTH Upcoming2027–2028標題／日期 vs2026–2027導言）

接待校資格參考：KTH exchange限協議partner在籍、不收free movers；一般須母校program已完成至少兩年、preferably more且above-average grades，Architecture須三年；doubledegree另需專agreement及三年，internships不給academiccredits且不可選課，不能混入一般exchange資格。（KTH未標年度incoming nondegree exchange，與doubledegree/dualMaster/internship分清）

接待校語言參考：KTH exchange不要求official language test results，強烈建議English相當European B2。B2是推薦，不得改為硬線，Swedish course placement或fee-paying degree語言班也不是初申英語要求。（KTH未標年度incoming nondegree exchange，與doubledegree/dualMaster/internship分清）

課程參考：KTH exchange每semester應選30ECTS，majority credits須在母校agreement選派studyarea並滿足每課prereq；Architecture須專exchangeagreement與三年completedstudy且固定plan。UG主要Swedish、Master主要English，不能把所有English master course都當UG保證可修。（KTH未標年度incoming exchange選課）

課程參考：交換生credit-bearing Swedish courses在MobilityOnline與一般課同樣申請並由coordinator錄取，A1以上有Swedish基礎須先做placement；free noncredit多semesterpackage主要給fee-payingMaster，其他學生只可視空位選intro，不套完整免費課包。（KTH未標年度incoming exchange在學語言課流程）

住宿參考：KTH incomingexchange含doubledegree/dualmaster：Fall錄取者May申校宿，Spring於November初開放7–10天；welcomeemail提供exactdeadline，有限房源不保證。Offer48小時內accept/decline，拒絕不再另給；不能套fee-payingdegree May4–31 guaranteedfirstyear分支。（KTH housing Group3 exchange，未標年一般申請窗口；錄取後住宿）

住宿參考：Group3 exchange住房原頁Spring2027 contract start January11/12（當semesterfirstdate及前一天），spring standardendJune30；FallstandardstartAug1/endJan7。這是住宿契約日期非exchange appdeadline，Spring2027不能轉2028。（KTH incoming exchange住房原Spring2027日期）

保險與簽證參考：KTH incomingexchange保障StudentIN（原連terms fromJuly1 2025），全學生另有校內/上下學途中的personalinjuryinsurance；仍應抵達前檢查offcampusmedical及landlordcoverage，需要則補私人保險。Fee-payingdegree FAS+不是exchange方案。（KTH未標年度insurance頁，exchange StudentIN與degree FAS+分支；termslink非已讀新來源）

行事曆參考：校曆headline與datedentries明示Autumn2027 Aug30–Jan17 2028、Spring2028 Jan18–June2 2028，但opening第二句仍稱upcoming及otherdates2026–27，保留internalversionconflict；programme course registration/exam dates不是交換申請deadline。（KTH upcoming2027–28calendar datedentries，正文殘留2026–27句）

【住宿資訊】
Housing
is not guaranteed, but accommodation is offered for exchange students based on the following conditions:
1. The exchange agreement is relatively well balanced with regard to incoming / outgoing students.
2. The application for housing in Uppsala is submitted on time and the student has accepted the offer by the deadline specified in the housing offer.

【實用資訊】
Basic Swedish language courses
run part time and as afternoon/evening classes, throughout both terms and are worth 7.5 credits. There are several levels available depending on Swedish language skills.
Housing, financing and health care
insurance: All exchange students who are physically in Sweden conducting on campus studies are
automatically covered by an insurance policy taken by Uppsala University,
Student IN, covering emergency medical care (for non-EU/EES citizens), liability coverage, legal coverage and accident insurance.
No purchase is necessary for the student.
For full details about the Student IN insurance, please visit
this website
.

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校公開資訊補查
student_guide_sections.summary: 依個別官方來源及原文件期間作參考；年度未明列者不認定為116-1最終規定。
points: 住宿參考：受Uppsala委託之Housing Office為交換生、付費生及訪問研究者提供非營利住宿服務，分Uppsala及Visby區域；特定群組及剩餘房源另有規則，不能混用校區或保證分配。（Uppsala University Housing Office受校方委託服務；Uppsala/Visby分開；未明列學年）
行事曆參考：Uppsala明列2027–28：秋季2027/8/30–2028/1/16、春季2028/1/17–6/4；Uppsala與Visby相距甚遠，課程必須集中其中一地。日期為校方接待學期，臺大甄選另核。（Uppsala university-wide exchange Academic year2027/2028；Uppsala／Gotland）
接待校文件參考：Uppsala校級協議提名後寄申請入口，處理申請時將成績單及課程計畫送系所審查；本段未列完整全部附件，不能宣稱新期文件已全核實。（University-wide agreements；提名後personal link）
課程參考：Uppsala選課需逐項先修及名額核可，固定錄取課程後通常不可更換、沒有add/drop期，例外為重疊或母校確認學程影響；不能同選Uppsala及Visby兩地。（University-wide incoming course rules；未標新期專屬）
保險與簽證參考：Uppsala交換生列Student IN保險，須另讀保障範圍及追加項目；非EU/EEA須參考移民署居留申請，校方簡介不等於臺灣個人完整簽證checklist。（Incoming exchange general information；未標新期）
接待校期限參考：Uppsala University-wide incoming個人申請秋4/15、春10/15；此是校級協議常年截止，院系協議須另通知，不能把department日期混作臺大校級deadline。（Uppsala university-wide常年deadline；未標2027）
接待校資格參考：Uppsala incoming須母校／母系／母院有交換協議且選拔提名；校級協議由國際流動單位辦理，院系協議由各院系另定表格及截止。（常年incoming；校級與院系協議不互換，不等同學位申請。）
接待校語言參考：Uppsala交換不要求語言證書或考試，但期待英文至少CEFR B2；申請自評，母校coordinator亦可能需確認B2，不能寫成必交IELTS最低分。（incoming exchange常年FAQ；瑞典語授課另須足夠瑞典語證明。）
課程參考：Uppsala incoming選課需提60 credits志願含備選，通常錄取全時30 credits/學期；非EU/EEA須維持30，EU/EEA最低22.5。須按各course實際日期和pace排課，非所有課並行。（校級協議incoming與學生國籍差異；60是初申選課備選總量，不是實際必修60/學期。）
住宿參考：Uppsala formal exchange是Housing Office優先服務群組，申請前收到註冊碼；學生住宿提前終止需三個完整calendar months通知，變更須書面依合約。（學生住宿Uppsala／Visby各區，非guest-researcher兩年合約或master-thesis資格。）
保險與簽證參考：正式協議incoming交換由Student IN在瑞典境內全天保障，期間學期開始前兩週至結束後兩週；醫院不能直接向保險收費，須先付／取invoice並經校方交換coordinator處理claim。（incoming Student IN；FAS+付費學位生與Student OUT出國生方案不混用。）

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校公開資訊補查
student_guide_sections.summary: 依個別官方來源及原文件期間作參考；年度未明列者不認定為116-1最終規定。
points: 接待校資格參考：须有正式交换协定并由母校在线提名；提名后自动寄送课程申请指示，各课程先修条件必须满足。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
接待校語言參考：正式交换协定学生不要求英文能力测验证明；这仅是接待校规则，不能取代臺大本期甄选语言门槛。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
住宿參考：录取后用录取通知链接建立住宿账户并排队，每日累计一点，不能保证房型或区域；人数多时每学期至少15 ECTS者优先。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
費用參考：按交换生可选课程申请者免Umeå学费；住宿及生活費仍另計。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
保險與簽證參考：交换生有Student IN，覆盖必要合理紧急医疗及牙科；完整条款与停留许可文件仍须按国籍、时间及个人情况核对。（接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果）
行事曆參考：2027秋季为2027/8/30–2028/1/16。2028春季概要末日误写为2027/6/4，而分期表写2028/6/4；保留版本矛盾，不能自行修正后视为最终行事曆。（Umeå行事曆；更新2026/8/24，2027秋季明确、2028春季年份矛盾）
接待校期限參考：Umeå常年提名秋季4/1、春季10/1；選課申請秋季4/15、春季10/15，假日延至下一工作日。提名入口只寄coordinator，個人唯一連結於提名後取得。（Umeå頁更新2025-09-01；未標2027）
課程參考：Umeå沒有一般add/drop，申請截止後換課限時程衝突或母校要求；可在其他30ECTS外另申請國際學生瑞典語課，住房優先15ECTS不是全校最低選課量。（Umeå exchange FAQ常年；未標年度）
接待校文件參考：Umeå課程先修正修者可先申請、但開課前須上傳成績單證明完成；此是條件錄取選課補件，完整exchange申請checklist仍須另讀Application instructions。（Umeå課程eligibility；頁更新2026/4/29）
課程參考：Umeå通常最多30ECTS/學期，初級瑞典語可額外加、總上限45；校方本身沒有mandatory最低ECTS，但非EU居留頁另要求30ECTS現場課，母校也可能設下限。新期個人安排須再核。（Umeå exchange課程通則；不同於居留／母校要求）
課程參考：Umeå瑞典語頁2026/10/7更新明說2027不提供incoming交換生瑞典語課（亦特別說Spring2027不開）。較舊FAQ／選課通則可加瑞典語至45ECTS只是常年說法，不代表2027有課；付費／獎學金生免費學語言為別身分。（incoming交換2027瑞典語供課限定；非一般英授課程停開）
接待校文件參考：Umeå國際指南列居留申請需全段可支用保證財力，舊2025額SEK10,584／月並明說每年更新；這是2025移民財力要求，非2027–28生活費估計或交換招生GPA。非EU長於3月須居留、30credits全時，不能把付費生先繳學費才審居留套免學費交換。（international student guide2026/6/26更新；財力數據明2025舊年，身分分別）
保險與簽證參考：Umeå交換Student IN在瑞典境內24小時保障，非課程的境外旅行不涵蓋；一般personal injury只限學習及直達通勤、FAS+給付費／獎學金生，均不能互相替代。住房／租客保險只是建議、若不足可自加保。（incoming正式協定交換之Student IN；國際指南未標適用學年）
接待校文件參考：Umeå有居留需求的交換生以上傳Notification of Selection Results證明校方保險；Learning Agreement由IO錄取後簽，Arrival／Stay最早迎新當日簽，不能列作臺大初申已簽文件。錄取課無需回覆，但不參加應在University Admissions自行decline。（incoming交換录取後文件與保險證明，常年FAQ）
住宿參考：Umeå Accommodation Service Spring2027推薦抵達1/17，該日亦租約最早入住／取鑰日，首期租金須已付、以護照核身；Infocenter關門時可MyPage Book Pickup登記朋友代領，朋友也須ID。這是前批租約，非Fall2027入住日。（Spring2027已簽校方住宿合約者，早於目標Fall2027）

cost_summary: 尚未取得並核對116-1適用資料；請向合作校確認。
housing_summary:
【住宿資訊】
Campus Rapperswil
:
The student hall of residence is conveniently located, just a five-minute bus ride from campus. Shared apartment of 3 or 6 rooms with exchange students. Current cost is CHF 680 per month. Application is submitted together with the student exchange application.
Campus Buchs:
No on-campus accommodation. Rooms in shared flats and private accommodation in or near Buchs, approx. CHF 400 - CHF 700 monthly.
Campus St.Gallen:
No on-campus accommodation. Rooms in shared flats and studios with other exchange students, CHF 550 - CHF 700 monthly. Application deadlines: 15 May/15 October.
transport_summary: 尚未取得並核對116-1適用資料；請向合作校確認。
campus_life_summary:
【實用資訊】
German beginner class offered every semester. Additonal courses can be organized according to demand. A
3-week intensive German refresher course
(B2/C1) is offered, which takes place before the start of the fall semester. Cost: CHF 700.
Appropriate expenses per month in CHF: Accommodation: 550 – 700, food: 400, public transport: 70, books: 60, health insurance (can be waived): 80; entertainment: 150
Total per month: 1300 – 1500
Students must have health insurance which is valid in Switzerland.
Non-EU Students:
Proof of health insurance valid in Switzerland. Health insurance provider in home country signs an exemption form together with a copy of the insurance policy in English, both documents will be evaluated by the local authorities in Switzerland. If the documents are not accepted by the local authorities, students are obliged to sign up for a Swiss health insurance (approx. CHF 90.00/month – e.g.
Foreign student health insurance Switzerland | Swisscare
).
Please note: The insurance policy has to explicitly and clearly state that the coverage is unlimited. Otherwise it won't be accepted in Switzerland.
A residence permit must be obtained after entering Switzerland. The costs for the visa and the residence permit are paid for by the student.

of the University of Zurich and ETH offers language courses for students from all fields of study for a fee between CHF 80- CHF 150-. There are also courses for international and exchange students like "German as a Foreign Language".
For anyone staying in Switzerland for longer than three months, it is compulsory to purchase Swiss health insurance. 接待校期限參考：一般協定校秋提名4/15、學生申請5/15；春提名9/15、學生申請9/30。頁未標學年，不寫成2027–28具年期限。（聖加倫Partner university exchange Bachelor/Master共通未標2027–28學年）

接待校語言參考：一般交換英／德授課期望CEFR B2，明說不需正式證書；iBT89/IELTS6.5及全英MBA豁免屬ISP，不是臺大一般Bachelor/Master交換門檻。（HSG Student Exchange FactSheet2026/27 p5；非2027–28規定）
費用參考：2026/27每月房租含utilities CHF700–1050、餐600、通訊70、交通180、保險100–280、休閒150、其他100–150；housing申請費250不退、簽證／permit66–240依國籍。住房額可更高，未把保險一律寫成20。（HSG Student Exchange FactSheet2026/27 p5；非2027–28規定）
住宿參考：同為2026/27，Partner頁連結PDF p5春住宿2/1–6/30；incoming總頁V05 PDF p5寫2/1–5/31。兩版秋同8/1–12/31、先到先得。結束日版本矛盾尚未定奪，不自行挑一版或標成未公告。（HSG Student Exchange FactSheet2026/27 p5；非2027–28規定；另V05 p5對照）
課程參考：2026/27一般交換至少16、最多40ECTS（THEMIS33）；本科一般讀本科，符合先修才能例外修研且不得研核心課；研可按必要修本科。確定課表約開學前1月，容量限制與bidding不保證全部志願。（HSG2026/27 factsheet p4；不是2027–28完整課程清單）

On-campus accommodation
Information about on-campus options can be viewed
here

must ensure they answer that they are a Monash Abroad applicant.
As rooms are limited and offered on a first-come, first-served basis, we recommend students apply as soon as possible.
Questions not answered on the website can be directed to
Monash Residential Services
.
Off-campus accommodation
If students choose to live off-campus, they can
receive assistance/advice
on searching for rental properties, setting up a share house, things to look out for before you sign a contract, an idea of comparable rental costs, how to budget, and how to get the essentials like internet, gas and electricity connected.

campus_life_summary:
【Campuses in Australia】
You can study your units across the Clayton and the Caulfield campuses. If you want, however, to study units taught at the Peninsula or Parkville campuses, you must take all of your units at that campus.
Clayton:
This is the main campus, where most disciplines are offered and only where Engineering, Science, and undergraduate Law are offered.
Caulfield:
The only campus where Art, Design, and Architecture are offered but within easy commuting distance to Clayton, and students studying Arts, Business or IT can study between the two campuses, timetable permitting. They must still be nominated to a primary campus.
Melbourne Law Chambers:
Postgraduate law students only.
(Not for exchange students)
Parkville:
Pharmacy students only.
(Not for exchange students)
Peninsula:
Not available in the application portal but a student with a particular reason to study there can be allocated there Monash University manually.

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校公開資訊補查
student_guide_sections.summary: 依個別官方來源及原文件期間作參考；年度未明列者不認定為116-1最終規定。
points: 接待校資格參考：Monash2027接收規則：學士在交換開始前完成一年，平均60%或GPA3.0/4.0或ECTS C／母校等值；碩士通常完成一年，同校同領域接續學位有例外。仍須符合英文與課程先修，不能取代臺大甄選條件。（Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認）
接待校文件參考：2027Monash需歷次／現校正式成績單及必要英文認證翻譯、英文能力證明（適用者）、護照個資頁、所選課先修證明／英文課綱；資料齊全後才評估申請。交換生必須等母校提名釋出專用表，誤用direct apply會轉為自費Study Abroad。（Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認）
接待校期限參考：Monash2027 Exchange接收申請：Semester1截止2026/11/1，Semester2截止2027/4/1，澳洲／馬來西亞同日；Study Abroad截止不同。這是接待校流程，不是臺大116-1報名期限，無法由此推定臺大名額。（Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認）

行事曆參考：Monash2027必到交換orientation：Australia Semester1抵達2/15、Semester2抵達7/19；Malaysia為2/17與7/14。交換orientation在全校orientation前一週、上課前兩週，無法按澳洲日期替代馬來西亞。（Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認）

課程參考：2027Monash校区與課程限制：Clayton工程／理／學士法、Caulfield藝設建築、Parkville藥學；Malaysia需整學期在該校區。其他Alfred/Gippsland/Prato/Singapore/Suzhou地點不可選；查Handbook是否開放exchange，通常每學期四課中最多一課線上，須6–8課備選。（Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認）
保險與簽證參考：Monash2027澳洲校區錄取接受與適用OSHC繳付證明後才出CoE，標準為subclass500 Non-Award；OSHC只基本醫療，不含國際旅行／行李等。Malaysia另需醫療保險付款後進行簽證；簽證由身分與當期政府規則決定。（Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認）
住宿參考：Monash2027澳洲住房可在未獲offer前申請校內、免申請費並標Monash Abroad；按先到先得配房。校外由校方提供搜尋與租屋支援，非保證。Malaysia住房與澳洲條件不得混用。（Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認）
費用參考：Monash2027文件区分：Exchange須母校雙邊提名，學費續向母校付；Study Abroad向Monash付。生活費链接主要為完整學位國際生，交換可能不同，未取一般學位價格作個人交換報價。（Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認）

if apply before deadline. Read more about accommodation below:
University Flats
The University of Otago is renowned for its residential campus environment and you are encouraged to apply for accommodation in one of our University Flats (Uni Flats). All Uni Flats are located within an easy walk of the University campus and main shopping centre. Students share the cleaning and cooking duties and usually shop together for food. The residential fee includes the cost of your room, electricity, internet, bed linen, community events and the services of the Uni Flats team. All Uni Flats are fully furnished, including a basic kitchen setup.
Apply for University Flats accommodation
In order to be considered for accommodation with Uni Flats you must first register and then apply online through the Student Accommodation Centre.

Student Accommodation at Victoria University of Wellington is very competitive. This means that students may not be placed in one of their initial choices for accommodation.
Accommodation applications open on
1 August each year
, and we strongly recommend applying as soon as they open.
Students can apply for accommodation
before they have been nominated or accepted
into the exchange programme.
It is particularly competitive for students coming for a single exchange term during Trimester 1 (February start) at Victoria University of Wellington.
Mature students or students who have experience living away from home are advised to consider the self-catered halls of residence. All students over the age of 20 will be offered a self-catered hall only.
All questions regarding accommodation applications should be directed to the
Accommodation Service
. We do not process accommodation applications and therefore have no impact on processing times.
